blocks.title: Commercial Engine
blocks.body: Garner Hotels commercial distribution rides IHG One Rewards direct channels, GDS, OTAs, and parent sales systems. IHG economy: essential rooms and efficient operations with IHG One Rewards distribution for value-conscious transient demand. Owners should underwrite channel mix and loyalty contribution for this asset—not corporate averages alone.

blocks.title: IHG One Rewards
blocks.body: Garner Hotels participates in IHG One Rewards. Members earn and redeem points and receive Elite recognition across participating sister brands. Confirm current tier names and earn rules on the official program site before IC.

blocks.title: Loyalty
blocks.body: IHG One Rewards at Garner Hotels

blocks.title: Earn
blocks.body: Guests earn IHG One Rewards points on qualifying stays at Garner Hotels. Elite members may receive enhanced earn and recognition benefits per current program rules.

blocks.title: Redeem
blocks.body: Points redeem for stays across the IHG One Rewards portfolio, including Garner Hotels, subject to availability and current redemption charts.

blocks.title: Elite Recognition
blocks.body: Elite status recognition (upgrades, late checkout, lounge access where offered) applies per property capability—delivery varies by hotel.

blocks.title: Ecosystem
blocks.body: IHG One Rewards partnerships, co-branded cards, and bonus campaigns expand the loyalty halo; Garner Hotels stays remain the property-level earn/redeem node.

blocks.title: Owner Lens

blocks.title: Systems Implications

blocks.title: Repeat Guest Capture

blocks.title: Why Value Is Strongest in These Scenarios
blocks.body:
Keep Local Product Intent—Add IHG One Rewards: retain Garner Hotels's brand promise while accessing loyalty earn/redeem and parent commercial systems a standalone hotel cannot buy alone.
IHG economy: essential rooms and efficient operations with IHG One Rewards distribution for value-conscious transient demand.
Sibling Clarity: diligence fit versus same-parent peers before assuming identical owner use case or fee path.
Operator & Owner Fit: strongest when the asset can deliver the brand's guest promise with QA discipline—weakest when sponsors want the flag without the product investment.
Disclosure Discipline: model economics only from current fee exhibits—Factory 2.0 does not invent undisclosed percentages.
